group.title: An award announcement
group.passage: F1: Before we close today's staff meeting, I have some good news. The regional business council has selected our company for its community partnership award. The award recognizes the volunteer repair sessions that our technicians run at local schools, not our sales performance. Several schools wrote to the council describing how the sessions helped students understand electronics through practical activities. The presentation will take place at the civic center on June twelfth. We have been offered six seats at the ceremony, and priority will go to employees who took part in the school visits. If you would like to attend, please contact me by Friday. We'll also display photographs from the program in the reception area next month.
group.passageZh: 今天員工會議結束前有個好消息：地區商業協會選本公司獲頒社區合作獎。表揚的是技師在地方學校辦的志工維修活動，不是銷售表現。幾所學校寫信說明這些實作活動如何幫助學生理解電子學。頒獎六月十二日在市民中心舉行，有六個席位，優先給參加過校訪的員工。有意出席者請最遲於星期五聯絡我，下個月接待區也將展示活動照片。

Before we close today's staff meeting, I have some good news. The Regional Business Council has selected our company for its Community Partnership Award. The award recognizes the volunteer repair sessions that our technicians run at local schools, not our sales performance. Several schools wrote to the council describing how the sessions helped students understand electronics through practical activities. The presentation will take place at the Civic Center on June 12th. We have been offered six seats at the ceremony and priority will go to employees who took part in the school visits. If you would like to attend, please contact me by Friday. We'll also display photographs from the program in the reception area next month.
